newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: ANI expects Ellicott comment in next day.
newsitem.headline: ANI expects Ellicott comment in next day.

text.p: Australian National Industries Ltd (ANI) said on Tuesday it expected to issue a statement about the Ellicott report into the acquisition of its ABT environmental unit within the next 24 hours.
The company said the report, prepared on behalf of the ANI board of directors by lawyer Bob Ellicott, was not likely to be released along with the statement.
ANI bought the ABT unit, based in Germany and now part of the company's Holter operation, when it was controlled by major shareholder Kerry Packer eight years ago.

The company said it had no comment on a report in the Sydney Morning Herald newspaper that ANI would not take legal action against those responsible for the acquisition and had passed the report on to the Australian Securities Commission for possible action.
